# News layer: first live run (25-Nov-2026 evening, file dated 2026-11-26 IST)

Tool: `tools/news/news.py --since 7d` (README in `tools/news/`). It ran 00:10 to 00:16 IST on 26-Nov-2026 (the evening of 25-Nov UTC),
so the output file carries the IST run date: `$FEIN_DATA/news/2026-11-26.md/.csv`.
Window: items published 19-Nov 00:10 to 26-Nov 00:16 IST. Watchlist: 90 tickers (8 live dives + 82 other paper-call names,
Indian and US). Stage 3 (signals), feeding stage 4 (deep dive) and 7 (scorekeeping). Research, not SEBI-registered advice.

**Nothing here has been acted on or verified.** These are headlines only (single source, unverified). Each one needs the
filing or a second dated source before it touches a card, a paper call or memdb.

   Haryana farmers halt supplies and demand ₹600/qtl SAP (20 to 25-Nov, several items); "Punjab raises sugarcane price to ₹431 per
   quintal for 2026–27" (25-Nov); "Sugar prices fall 20% as Centre tightens supply monitoring, introduces fortnightly quota"
   (23-Nov; the number is suspect, verify); India allocates 8,606 t raw-sugar US TRQ (25-Nov). The UP SAP decision itself was not seen this week.
2. **Utkarsh Small Finance Bank (UTKARSHBNK), L41:** RBI Governor met NBFC/MFI heads on 23-Nov ("microfinance stress, gold loans,

3. **Sunflag Iron and Steel (SUNFLAG):** "Construction equipment makers seek relief from 12% steel safeguard duty" (25-Nov).

## Lessons from the first run (already folded into the code)
- One-word bases from names are dangerous: "Kirby Corporation" stripped to "Kirby" pulled in about 60 college-football and Nintendo headlines.
  Short NSE codes too: HARSHA pulled in Harsha Bhogle and Sri Lankan politics. Now only names of 2+ words, hand-picked
  aliases, and NSE codes of 8+ letters that are not a word in the name are used.
- "FDA approval" is not a material event; it is now tagged `usfda_nod`. Adverse FDA actions (warning letter, 483, import alert, OAI) stay material.
- Policy queries need `India`/`-Pakistan` qualifiers. The hospital query originally matched a Britannica page.
- The rules were re-applied to this run's saved rows offline after those fixes, to avoid re-fetching about 110 Google feeds. Raw rows are in
  `$FEIN_DATA/news/2026-11-26.csv` (outside git).
